episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: From a breakup to work stress, life isn't all that peachy for 35-year-old Jin Ah. Meanwhile, Jun Hee arrives back in Korea after three years abroad.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: One of Jin Ah's co-workers takes a liking to Jun Hee. Jin Ah's mom begins to worry because Jin Ah isn't preparing to get married like others her age.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Gyu Min goes around saying that Jin Ah likes Jun Hee, but no one believes him. Jun Hee seems to think Jin Ah wants to get back together with Gyu Min.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Although happily in love, Jin Ah still has concerns about her relationship. She volunteers to go on a business trip that no one else wants to take on.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Setting aside her guilt, Jin Ah spends the night at Jun Hee's place. Back at work after the business trip, she gets called to Director Nam's office.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: For Jun Hee, keeping his relationship a secret starts to get frustrating. President Jo asks the female employees to bring forth their grievances.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Seung Ho is angry with Jun Hee. Jin Ah runs into issues while trying to replace her broken smartphone because the account is under Gyu Min's name.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: When no one seems to know where Jin Ah is, Jun Hee starts to panic. Worried for her safety, he tries to get hold of Gyu Min.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Refusing help from her father and Jun Hee, Jin Ah plans to break the news to her mother and Gyung Sun herself, but it doesn't go as smoothly as she hoped.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: As everyone predicted, Jin Ah's mother reacts rather melodramatically to Jin Ah's news, injuring herself and hurting others' feelings in the process.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Jun Hee is more concerned about Jin Ah's feelings than his own, and refuses to give up his relationship with Jin Ah despite her mother's hurtful words.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: With Gyung Sun and Jun Hee's father sitting close by, Jin Ah isn't able to focus on her blind date, who takes notice and obviously isn't pleased.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Furious at Jin Ah, Jun Hee cuts of communication with her completely, which makes her worry. Jun Hee's father calls Jin Ah's father and asks to meet.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: After making her shocking announcement, Jin Ah pays a surprise late-night visit to Jun Hee's place. Jin Ah is told by her mother to move out of the house.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Jin Ah tries to keep her housing situation a secret from Jun Hee. Meanwhile at Jin Ah's company, there's much scheming going on behind her back.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Memories of their happy past come flooding back when Jin Ah and Jun Hee see each other for the first time in months, but this only adds to their pain.
